title: No page answers the local AI-style questions ('best community app / yoga community in San Diego', 'things to do in Encinitas'), and the home FAQ gives only one generic 'where available' answer.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/marketing/quick-answers.ts:56-60 single availability answer; grep of lib/marketing for 'yoga' finds only a funnel-config sentence (funnel-config.ts:502); /for/* and /vs pages carry no city or category-by-town FAQ.

WHY IT MATTERS: AI engines quote pages that state the answer verbatim with the place name. Without them Frequency will not be cited for local discovery queries at launch.

FIX DIRECTION: Add answer-first FAQs (FAQPage schema) to the town pages and /for/studios: 'Where can I find yoga/run-club/community groups in North County San Diego?' with named towns, and mirror them in llms-full.txt.

2026-11-16: localAnswers() in lib/marketing/quick-answers.ts (community groups, yoga and run clubs, things to do in Encinitas/Carlsbad/Oceanside, good app for San Diego groups) feeds the hub FAQ, llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Not done: a city-by-category FAQ on the /for/<niche> doors (for example /for/studios).
